tools\d-bound.py:5: `O`, so differencing them eliminates it and leaves `d` and the streaming path's
tools\d-bound.py:6: rowset machinery `M`:

tools\d-bound.py:8:     stock:      O + dA + 0.320*(h*d + (1-h)*c) = 24.41 ms  (anchor, 40.96 tok/s, ctx 52,819)
tools\d-bound.py:9:     streaming:  O + 0.320*d + M                = I        (fitted intercept, no bytes staged)
tools\d-bound.py:10:

tools\d-bound.py:12: attention the anchor pays at 52,819 tokens of context and the short-context
tools\d-bound.py:13: streaming runs do not (ctx 768 / 1280): expected ~0.6-1.0 ms from reading
tools\d-bound.py:14: 574.7 MB of device-resident q8 KV per token, unmeasured, so it is reported
tools\d-bound.py:15: as a sensitivity rather than subtracted.
tools\d-bound.py:16: 
tools\d-bound.py:17: Recomputed 2026-09-30 after h_stock was measured off the anchor's fitter log
tools\d-bound.py:18: (0.188, tools/hstock-from-log.py) rather than guessed at 9/40 = 0.225.
tools\d-bound.py:19: 
tools\d-bound.py:20: Recomputed again 2026-09-30 (eighteenth finding): the 28.92 ms intercept came
tools\d-bound.py:21: from pooling cache-off and cache-on arms, which run different execution shapes
tools\d-bound.py:22: (src/llama-layer-streaming.cpp load_row_set, retention branch), and is biased
tools\d-bound.py:23: up. The cache-on-only fits are the path's own intercepts.
tools\d-bound.py:24: """
tools\d-bound.py:25: 
tools\d-bound.py:26: C_HOST_US, TOP_K, N_LAYER = 35.7, 8, 40
tools\d-bound.py:27: STOCK_MS = 1000.0 / 40.96
tools\d-bound.py:28: H_STOCK = (5192.44 - 1921.0) / (N_LAYER * (432.0 + 3.1875))
